content_items_media_has_asset.name: content_items_media_has_asset
content_items_media_has_asset.value: "content_items"."kind" NOT IN ('audio', 'video') OR "content_items"."media_asset_id" IS NOT NULL

content_items_published_media_has_transc.name: content_items_published_media_has_transcript
content_items_published_media_has_transc.value: "content_items"."kind" NOT IN ('audio', 'video') OR "content_items"."status" = 'draft' OR "content_items"."transcript" IS NOT NULL OR "content_items"."transcript_is_section_text"

assessment_attempts_score_range.name: assessment_attempts_score_range
assessment_attempts_score_range.value: "assessment_attempts"."score_raw" IS NULL OR ("assessment_attempts"."score_max" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."score_raw" BETWEEN 0 AND "assessment_attempts"."score_max")

moderation_batches_closed_fields.name: moderation_batches_closed_fields
moderation_batches_closed_fields.value: ("moderation_batches"."status" = 'closed') = ("moderation_batches"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_batches"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL)

enrolment_qcto_records_flc_number_requir.name: enrolment_qcto_records_flc_number_required
enrolment_qcto_records_flc_number_requir.value: "enrolment_qcto_records"."flc_code" IS NULL OR "enrolment_qcto_records"."flc_code" NOT IN ('01', '02', '03', '08') OR "enrolment_qcto_records"."flc_statement_number" IS NOT NULL

learner_qcto_profiles_area_needs_provinc.name: learner_qcto_profiles_area_needs_province
learner_qcto_profiles_area_needs_provinc.value: "learner_qcto_profiles"."statssa_area_code" IS NULL OR "learner_qcto_profiles"."province_code" IS NOT NULL

learner_qcto_profiles_name_format.name: learner_qcto_profiles_name_format
learner_qcto_profiles_name_format.value:
("learner_qcto_profiles"."first_name" IS NULL OR "learner_qcto_profiles"."first_name" ~ '^[^[:space:]]')
        AND ("learner_qcto_profiles"."middle_name" IS NULL OR "learner_qcto_profiles"."middle_name" ~ '^[^[:space:]]')
        AND ("learner_qcto_profiles"."last_name" IS NULL OR "learner_qcto_profiles"."last_name" ~ '^[^[:space:]]')

qcto_submission_batches_generated_fields.name: qcto_submission_batches_generated_fields
qcto_submission_batches_generated_fields.value:
"qcto_submission_batches"."status" = 'draft' OR ("qcto_submission_batches"."file_name" IS NOT NULL AND "qcto_submission_batches"."file_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "qcto_submission_batches"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "qcto_submission_batches"."file_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "qcto_submission_batches"."row_count" IS NOT NULL
        AND "qcto_submission_batches"."generated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "qcto_submission_batches"."generated_by" IS NOT NULL)

qcto_submission_batches_submitted_fields.name: qcto_submission_batches_submitted_fields
qcto_submission_batches_submitted_fields.value: "qcto_submission_batches"."status" IN ('draft', 'generated') OR ("qcto_submission_batches"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "qcto_submission_batches"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL)
